message.content: According to the conversation, Dyllan describes the combat in "Horizon Forbidden West" as both challenging and immersive. He notes that the combat can be tricky sometimes, particularly when dealing with flying machines, which require careful handling and strategic use of abilities like elemental arrows to stun them. Additionally, Dyllan appreciates the diverse environments in the game, each presenting its own unique challenges. He emphasizes the convenience and enjoyment of the Control Center, mentioning that it makes switching between games and apps much smoother. Overall, the combat seems to offer a blend of strategic depth and tactical engagement, which Dyllan finds very appealing.
